author: Laura Chen
title: The one mistake I see in 90% of beginners' front stances (and how to fix it in 10 minutes)
body: After coaching 200+ students, the single most common stance error is foot width. Most beginners stand with feet too narrow — this destroys your stability on all forward strikes. Here's a simple wall drill that fixes it immediately...
